title: Frontend Engineer (m/f/x)
description:
At go-e, we have been pursuing the development of our vision with passion and strength from the very beginning. We are moving in an area that is characterized by breakthroughs and growth and that requires a lot of personal responsibility and creative solution finding. On our journey towards the energy transition, the mixture of innovation and security, regional and international, self-realization and professionalism is the ideal fuel for our mutual growth.

Help build the Portal, a modern web platform for fleet managers and technicians. As a Frontend Engineer (m/f/x), you will turn product ideas into responsive, accessible interfaces using React and TypeScript. Join a collaborative team that values autonomy, ownership, code quality, and learning, and deliver features with visible customer impact.

With your contribution, you will impact how people will charge their cars in the future. Come and join the team in Berlin (GER) that is building the future of innovative charger solutions for e-mobility!

Your area of responsibility

  • Build and deliver frontend features for the Portal using React and TypeScript.
  • Work with product, design, and backend specialists to translate requirements into user interfaces.
  • Integrate RESTful APIs and WebSocket communication, including asynchronous data, caching, and error handling.
  • Write clean, maintainable, performant code and unit and integration tests.
  • Contribute to code reviews, design discussions, and frontend architectural decisions.
  • Troubleshoot existing features, improve performance, and share knowledge with other engineers.

Who we’re looking for:

  • Strong experience building web applications with React and TypeScript.
  • Experience with server-side rendering frameworks such as Next.js.
  • Proficiency with modern frontend tooling and state management, such as Redux or React Context.
  • Solid knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, CSS-in-JS or styled-components, and responsive or adaptive design.
  • Familiarity with UI component libraries, design systems, and accessibility best practices.
  • Experience with frontend build tools such as Webpack, Vite, or Babel, including bundler optimization.
  • Ability to integrate APIs and WebSocket communication and manage asynchronous data flows, errors, and caching.
  • An independent approach, ownership of your work, and clear communication with product, design, and engineering colleagues.

Even better would be

  • Experience writing developer tools, internal packages, or SDKs.
  • Contributions to open-source projects.
  • Experience in startup or fast-paced environments.
  • Deeper familiarity with real-time or WebSocket architectures.
  • (Not a must) Proficiency in one or more backend languages / frameworks (e.g. Node.js / Express / NestJS / TypeScript, or similar)

What we offer

  • Be one of the key drivers of our core technologies
  • A high degree of freedom in the execution of your projects
  • Flexible working hours
  • Mental well-being support via nilo.health
  • Employee discounts on our products
  • Corporate discounts on a variety of brands
About go-e
We are a fast-growing, successful company in the field of e-mobility and have developed from a start-up to an internationally recognized player. From our headquarters in Carinthia, Austria, we have already expanded to around 20 European countries. With bold ideas based on our passion for innovative e-mobility solutions, we are already establishing future technologies today.
